```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```
```{r}
#read csv file
bird_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(bird_breeding_sites)
```
Examining file's data 
```{r}
#view column names
colnames(bird_breeding_sites)

#summary of data frame, list of column and elements it is under
glimpse(bird_breeding_sites)

#see number of rows
print(nrow(bird_breeding_sites))

#see number of columns
print(ncol(bird_breeding_sites))

#see number of rows and columns
print(dim(bird_breeding_sites))
```

Reading the migration CSV file
```{r}
#reading csv file, head = see top 10 rows
bird_migration_sites <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(bird_migration_sites))

```
```{r}
glimpse(bird_migration_sites)

#100 rows, 34 columns
#Tag column has character data type, birth has numeric data type

colnames(bird_migration_sites)
```

Selecting columns
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)

#To not include duplicated rows
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct()

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```

Filtering and renaming columns
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```

filtering and renaming for migration data
```{r}
bird_migration_selected <- bird_migration_sites |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
distinct() |>
rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude,
Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

gt(bird_migration_selected)
```
Filtering data frame
```{r}
#breeding sites
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")

gt(bird_breeding_exc) 

#migration sites
bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_selected |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")

gt(bird_migration_exc)
```

Grouping data
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)

#grouped data frame can't really be visualised => use glimpse
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)
```
```{r}
#create new data frame, with 1 column that contains maximum value in the Stopover_Latitude for each site
#na.rm = TRUE => tells R to ignore any rows with "NA"
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))

gt(lat_df)
```

```{r}
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(lat_df)
```

Data frame with median values for all latitude and longitude columns
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)

bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

Combining data frames
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_summary)

gt(combined_bird_data)
```
